title: PDEA conducts random drug tests for Cotabato drivers, conductors

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in the Bangsamoro Region in Muslim Mindanao (PDEA-BARMM) conducted surprise drug tests on public transport workers on Tuesday, Oct. 27, to ensure safety as commuters head to the provinces for Undas 2026. “Oplan Harabas” or “Drug Test Muna Bago Pasada” is a nationwide operation led by the PDEA involving simultaneous, surprise mandatory drug testing for public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers and conductors. The initiative aims to prevent road accidents, ensure passenger safety, and promote a drug-free public transport system. READ: PDEA: 84 drivers test positive for drug use in Holy Week ops Paul […]...
